Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the game board containing the order queue, decks, offer track, rows of cards, and manages round updates and active players.

  • Constructor Details

    • Board

      public Board(List<Player> players, int numPlayers, List<Integer> foodModifiers, List<Card> tribeDeck, Map<Integer, List<Building>> buildingDeck, List<OfferTrackCard> offerTrack, long seed) throws RuntimeException
      Constructs a new Board, initializes rows, decks, and queues, and seeds the initial setup of cards across the rows.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of participating players
      numPlayers - the total number of players
      foodModifiers - the list of food modifiers for the turn order queue
      tribeDeck - the list of cards to populate the tribe deck
      buildingDeck - the map of buildings categorized by era
      offerTrack - the tiles of the offer track
      seed - the random seed used to shuffle turn order
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an unexpected action type is encountered while drawing cards

      public void setPlayerOnTrack(Player player, int position) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalMoveException
      Places the player on the given offer track slot.

      player - the player to place
      position - the chosen position (0-based)
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the position is not valid

    • increaseCurrEra

      public void increaseCurrEra()
      Advances to the next era: removes the buildings from the bottom, moves those in the top to the bottom and reveals the new buildings of the next era in the top.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if it tries to go past era 3

    • replenishTopRow

      public void replenishTopRow(int amount)
      Draws amount cards from the tribe deck and adds them to the top row. If a card belongs to an era later than the current one, it increments the era.
      Parameters:
      amount - the number of cards to draw

    • isOfferResolved

      public boolean isOfferResolved(GameObserver observer, Player player)
      Checks whether all the player's available actions have been resolved. If the FOOD action is left, it directly adds 3 food and considers it resolved.

      player - the current player
      Returns:
